contract.outcome: Quantify actually completed non-fused cached-property and present-array reads by result type, immediate following operation and whether that operation uses the produced result; include already frame-free getter return transport separately.
contract.hypothesis: Current Long-only regions miss opaque heap and predicate/call transport work. Actual value/consumer distribution will determine whether a broader region can stop before calls or needs a common read/call ownership boundary from its first vertical slice.
contract.scope: Private vm-stats-only counters at existing successful read/materialization sites. No PHP behavior, new IR, relaxed guard, new unsafe block/function or owner invariant. The existing getter helper reads its live caller metadata under its established unsafe contract. Counts are whole-request descriptive coverage, not measured native savings. Immediate relation denotes operand-field matches only, never ReleaseTemps range bounds. A bounded conservative same-frame dispatch witness records the actual next operation after up to four cleanup markers when the produced slot is outside every release interval; unexpected callbacks/edges discard that witness.
contract.ownership: Sole integrating task; production stays unchanged.
gates: Pinned release vm-stats build inside verified 6GiB/no-swap boundary and exclusive benchmark lock
Same actual five files/twenty findings and exact PHP/baseline/probe stdout/ordinary stderr
Focused object/array/reference/property-scope getter control outputs and expected counter relation cells
Source fingerprint unchanged in production and existing unsafe counts unchanged
Counter totals reconcile independently across all dimensions
ReleaseTemps interval endpoints are never reported as value consumers; unexpected dispatch/frame changes clear the post-cleanup witness.
contract.stop_rule: Do not implement a read-only region if its actual following-operation distribution cannot support a material target budget. Existing getter frame elision and string-length fusion must not be counted as new coverage.

initial_probe.limitation: First probe matched cleanup range bounds as if they were operand fields. Those field-match counts are not semantic consumers and are superseded by the refined observer; value-tag and next-opcode marginals are unchanged.

limitations: Counts cover the whole request; they do not establish analysis-only native instruction or time savings.
Field matches describe op1/op2 storage relationships, not a complete semantic operand-role decoder; relation zero does not prove no later use.
Post-cleanup observations are conservative same-frame ordered dispatch witnesses. Any unexpected frame, callback or control edge cancels them; they are not an optimizer safety proof.
Readonly means zero instruction flags and TMP/VAR result only; it does not prove absence of all PHP effects.
Scope metadata alone does not prove a reusable property guard. Existing direct getter elision and string-length fusion must not be counted as new optimization.
No combined admission relaxation, new IR execution, native ARM64 result or parity gain is claimed.
